question: Havajská pizza so šunkou a ananásom je takmer v každej slovenskej pizzerii. Nevznikla však na Havaji ani v Taliansku. Vymyslel ju grécky prisťahovalec. V ktorej krajine?
source_excerpt: Sam Panopoulos, a Greek-born Canadian, is credited with creating the first Hawaiian pizza in 1962 at the Satellite Restaurant in Chatham-Kent, Ontario, Canada.

extra.why_interesting: Players assume Hawaiian pizza comes from Hawaii or Italy. The stem rules out both. That leaves a reasoning path: canned pineapple, North America, a famous immigrant country. The answer, Canada, gives a satisfying 'really?' moment.
extra.verification_notes: Sam Panopoulos, a Greek immigrant, is credited with inventing Hawaiian pizza in Chatham, Ontario, Canada in 1962; the competing claims (Portland 1957, Toast Hawaii) don't involve a Greek immigrant or a ham-and-pineapple pizza.

explanation: Sam Panopoulos ju začal piecť vo svojej reštaurácii v kanadskom Ontáriu. Názov dostala jednoducho podľa značky ananásovej konzervy, ktorú používal.

question: Pizza Margherita, tá najjednoduchšia, ktorú mnohí Slováci ešte polejú kečupom, má len paradajky, mozzarellu a bazalku. Podľa legendy tie tri farby neboli náhoda. Čo mali pripomínať?
source_excerpt: Queen Margherita preferred a pizza swathed in the colours of the national flag of Italy: red tomato, white mozzarella, green basil.

extra.why_interesting: Slovaks see Margherita as the plain, cheapest pizza on the menu, often drowned in ketchup, and assume its three toppings are just the basic minimum. In fact the colours were reportedly chosen on purpose as a patriotic tribute. A player can reason it out by naming the colours (red, white, green), which makes it an 'I can work this out!' moment.
extra.verification_notes: The legend ties the red, white and green of tomato, mozzarella and basil to the Italian flag, as stated at https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pizza_Margherita.

explanation: Neapolský pizzar ju vraj upiekol na počesť kráľovnej Margherity Savojskej: červená, biela a zelená ako talianska trikolóra. Pizza potom dostala kráľovnino meno.
